summary: Figshare contains 17,808 neuronal pseudobulk effects for three infanticidal males relative to three allopaternal males. HypoExplorer aggregates all retained MPOA singlet nuclei per animal, and none of its four registered contrasts compares those two groups in either direction.

Versioned Figshare deposit with neuronal pseudobulk results and figure data

GEO series and deposited single-animal Seurat objects

verificationReview.reason: The authors aggregated neuronal RNA counts by animal and used Seurat FindMarkers with the DESeq2 test for infanticidal relative to allopaternal males. Positive CSV avg_log2FC values favour infanticidal males. Figure 3i plots the negative of that column. The registered edgeR fits pool all retained MPOA singlets per animal and compare alloparental males, infanticidal males or sires with naive controls, and dams with sires. The author code includes control-versus-allopaternal calls in immediate-early-gene-positive neurons. The supplement reports insufficient Fos-positive control neurons for that subset comparison. The per-animal neuronal Agouti table relates expression to care, and its reported AvgASIP cannot be recovered from its displayed ASIP and nNeurons columns. The qPCR validation uses an independent sample of 23 males. The GEO objects contain per-animal counts and QC. Across the reviewed sources, all four registered contrasts lack paired author effects or inference.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if an author table becomes available for all retained MPOA nuclei in a registered case and baseline, with the animal assignments, feature definitions and effect direction. Species mapping and the dam–sire pairing remain separate processing and design questions.

computed.claim: Content of the Figshare neuronal result
computed.value: All 17,808 rows have distinct nonblank feature labels and finite avg_log2FC. The same 17,675 rows have finite p_val and p_val_adj. Both statistics are missing for the other 133. Across all finite rows, p_val_adj equals min(1, 18,355 × p_val) to the precision of the CSV. This is a Bonferroni adjustment, although the Figure 3i caption describes FDR.

computed.claim: Author export and registered group pairs
computed.value: Neurons_Pseudobulk_REV25.R lines 71–85 aggregate neuronal RNA by group and orig.ident, then test RInfa relative to RAllo. Line 99 exports bulk.de. The adjusted-P filter creates a separate object, sig_res. Line 102 relabels source feature a as Agouti for display, and line 118 reverses the horizontal axis by plotting −avg_log2FC. Zero of the four registered case/baseline pairs matches the exported pair in either orientation.

computed.claim: Registered edgeR output rows, verified against the per-contrast provenance hashes
computed.value: 16,441 alloparental versus control, 16,336 infanticidal versus control, 16,523 sire versus control and 15,478 dam versus sire. Paths and SHA-256 values appear in audit.json and SEARCH_LOG.md.

computed.claim: Scope of the single-gene Figshare table
computed.value: ASIP_Behavior_Connection.csv has 17 distinct animal IDs across five groups (3 infa, 3 ambicon, 3 allo, 4 sire and 4 dam). Dividing ASIP by nNeurons reproduces AvgASIP at its printed precision in 0 of 17 rows. For RAllo3, 482 / 473 gives 1.019027484, while the deposited AvgASIP is 0.202959831. The author code uses ASIP for the care correlation at line 166 of Neurons_ASIP_Specific.R.

All 17 single-animal Seurat objects contain one RNA counts layer and zero feature-metadata columns. Together they contain 164,507 nuclei. SOFT identifies the 17 individual files, the archive member list confirms their byte sizes, and the retained source manifest confirms their SHA-256 values. The series matrix has a 17-sample header and zero feature rows.

openIssues: The inspected sources supply no gene-level author estimate for a registered all-singlet MPOA contrast. Neither author-concordance-v2 route can be assessed, and no contrast earns full verification.
Striped-mouse feature mapping to mouse annotation and the omitted mating-pair term in the dam-versus-sire model remain open under their existing reviews.
